**Management Summary – Project LV 160,242 €**

The tender suffers from critical specification gaps that jeopardize cost control and compliance with VOB/A. High‑risk items (total ≈ 9,500 €) lack essential technical data: site establishment, frost‑protection layer, concrete shaft class, and PE‑HD pipe specifications. Medium‑risk gaps (≈ 15,000 €) affect paving, asphalt base and wearing courses, masonry, plaster, insulation, and water‑exposure classes, all of which impede accurate estimating and may trigger disputes. A low‑risk lump‑sum for site setup (1,250 €) could shift risk unfairly to the contractor. Immediate actions: (1) revise all high‑priority clauses with concrete material classes, thicknesses, performance criteria, and standards; (2) supplement medium‑risk items with missing technical parameters; (3) reassess lump‑sum pricing to align risk allocation. Closing these gaps will improve bid reliability and reduce exposure to change orders.
